summary.text: Brian Baca is a Republican state representative from New Mexico House District 8 who was appointed to the seat in January 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Katherine Gauer.

paragraphs.text: Baca was appointed to the New Mexico House of Representatives to replace Representative Alonzo Baldonado, and he assumed office on January 19, 2022.
He won the seat in the general elections of November 2022 and November 2024 and advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Appropriations and Finance, Commerce and Economic Development, and House Education committees.
